question: Which of the following countries will be hosting the World Rowing Championships 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shanghai, China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The World Rowing Championships** is a premier international rowing regatta organized by **World Rowing (FISA)**.
 
• The prestigious event for **2025** will be hosted in **Shanghai, China**, which is known for its modern infrastructure and capability to host international sports events.
